{{Top|leg}}
The '''deputy minister of trade''' was a [[Politics/Legends|political]] position held by a member in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. In [[43 ABY]], [[Unidentified deputy minister of trade|one such]] deputy minister of trade was located in the [[Galactic Empire Embassy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when a [[Kidnap attempt in the Galactic Empire Embassy Complex|kidnap attempt]] was made on the Imperial [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]. Fel shot his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] several times into the ceiling in order to trip off an alarm, accidentally shooting the deputy minister of trade in the foot. The alarms caused several aides to come to Fel's rescue, however, and the kidnap attempt was foiled.
